professionalScope.en: Continuing professional education for licensed clinicians and allied providers. Every learner gets the same evidence, regulatory status and safety content; what each may do with it — prescribe, recommend, administer, or refer — follows their own licence and scope, and the course adapts its practice guidance to that role. It informs clinical reasoning; it is not a protocol, contains no dosing, and does not replace specialist input, formal guidelines or individual judgment.
professionalScope.es-MX: Educación profesional continua para médicos y profesionales de la salud con cédula profesional. Todos los participantes reciben la misma evidencia, estatus regulatorio y contenido de seguridad; lo que cada uno pueda hacer con ello —prescribir, recomendar, administrar o derivar— depende de su propia cédula y campo de ejercicio profesional, y el curso adapta sus pautas de práctica a dicho rol. Fundamenta el razonamiento clínico; no constituye un protocolo, no contiene dosificaciones y no sustituye la opinión del especialista, las guías formales ni el juicio clínico individual.

disclaimers.en: Educational content for clinicians. It does not prescribe, and it never restates an evidence grade above what the source assigns to the specific indication.
disclaimers.es-MX: Contenido educativo para médicos. No prescribe y nunca reformula un nivel de evidencia por encima del asignado por la fuente a la indicación específica.

disclaimers.en: The source explains US and other countries' rules as comparisons. Mexico product registration, indication, route and professional-practice status require current checks with COFEPRIS and local review before clinical use.
disclaimers.es-MX: El contenido original explica normas de Estados Unidos y de otros países como ejemplos comparativos. El registro, la indicación, la vía de administración y las reglas profesionales aplicables en México deben verificarse con COFEPRIS y revisarse localmente antes de tomar decisiones clínicas.

note.en: primary regulatory source (register) · issuing authority · role: United Arab Emirates regulatory status · read 2026-09-25 · Searched 25 Sep 2026 by ingredient (IngredientName, substring match) and product name (SearchTerm), e.g. https://services.ede.gov.ae/drugdirectory?IngredientName=semaglutide&ViewMode=list&PageSize=100. Every row returned was 'Active'; the directory has no status filter, so withdrawn or cancelled registrations may not appear. Rows give classification, strength, form, manufacturer, status and registration date; detail pages add dispensing mode and a therapeutic category but no indications. Quotes join table cells with ' | ' and page fields with spaces; '…' marks omitted cells or fields. Searches with no hits: retatrutide, afamelanotide, Scenesse, melanotan, Melanotan, tesamorelin, Tesamorelin, Egrifta, sermorelin, Sermorelin, ipamorelin, Ipamorelin, CJC, CJC-1295, ibutamoren, Ibutamoren, MK-677, BPC-157, BPC 157, pentadecapeptide, TB-500, TB500, thymosin, Thymosin, thymosin beta, KPV, LL-37, cathelicidin, GHK (ingredient and product name), prezatide, copper tripeptide, copper peptide, thymulin, Thymulin, PTD, DBM, PTD-DBM, Zepbound, Loniten, Minoxidil tablet, growth hormone, Skytrofa. 'BPC' as an ingredient matched only two unrelated products whose ingredients carry the 'BPC' pharmacopoeia suffix (Permethrin BPC, Cajuput Oil BPC). 'tripeptide' as an ingredient returned 7 rows: Martiderm anti-hair-loss ampoules, lotion and shampoos (biotinoyl tripeptide-1; GSL products) and the ST500 gel medical device (SH-tripeptide-1).
note.es-MX: fuente regulatoria primaria (registro) · autoridad emisora · rol: estatus regulatorio en los Emiratos Árabes Unidos · consultado el 2026-09-25 · Búsqueda realizada el 25 de septiembre de 2026 por principio activo (IngredientName, coincidencia de subcadena) y nombre del producto (SearchTerm), p. ej., https://services.ede.gov.ae/drugdirectory?IngredientName=semaglutide&ViewMode=list&PageSize=100. Todos los registros obtenidos figuraban como 'Active'; el directorio no dispone de filtro de estatus, por lo que los registros retirados o cancelados podrían no aparecer. Las filas indican clasificación, concentración, forma farmacéutica, fabricante, estatus y fecha de registro; las páginas de detalle añaden la modalidad de dispensación y una categoría terapéutica, pero no las indicaciones. Las citas unen las celdas de la tabla con ' | ' y los campos de la página con espacios; '…' señala celdas o campos omitidos. Búsquedas sin resultados: retatrutide, afamelanotide, Scenesse, melanotan, Melanotan, tesamorelin, Tesamorelin, Egrifta, sermorelin, Sermorelin, ipamorelin, Ipamorelin, CJC, CJC-1295, ibutamoren, Ibutamoren, MK-677, BPC-157, BPC 157, pentadecapeptide, TB-500, TB500, thymosin, Thymosin, thymosin beta, KPV, LL-37, cathelicidin, GHK (principio activo y nombre de producto), prezatide, copper tripeptide, copper peptide, thymulin, Thymulin, PTD, DBM, PTD-DBM, Zepbound, Loniten, Minoxidil tablet, growth hormone, Skytrofa. 'BPC' como principio activo coincidió únicamente con dos productos no relacionados cuyos ingredientes llevan el sufijo farmacopeico 'BPC' (Permethrin BPC, Cajuput Oil BPC). 'tripeptide' como principio activo arrojó 7 filas: ampollas, loción y champús anticaída de Martiderm (biotinoyl tripeptide-1; productos de venta libre [GSL]) y el dispositivo médico en gel ST500 (SH-tripeptide-1).

citations.title: Neuro-immuno-endocrinology of the skin: how environment regulates body homeostasis
citations.authors: Slominski RM, Raman C, Jetten AM, Slominski AT

note.en: narrative review · academic · role: A&RE ch.6 ref 1 — the four immuno-endocrine units (epidermal, dermal, hypodermal, adnexal) and the three routes (local, neural, circulation) · PMID 40263492 · Publisher correction PMID 40316721. Guide reference resolves exactly.
note.es-MX: revisión narrativa · académica · rol: ref. 1 del cap. 6 de A&RE — las cuatro unidades inmunoendocrinas (epidérmica, dérmica, hipodérmica, anexial) y las tres vías (local, neural, circulación) · PMID 40263492 · Corrección del editor PMID 40316721. La referencia de la guía coincide con exactitud.

citations.title: Neuroendocrinology of the skin

note.en: narrative review · academic · role: A&RE ch.5 ref 3, ch.6 ref 3, ch.7 ref 4 — CRH, POMC, ACTH, α-MSH and β-endorphin are made in skin with their receptors (para/autocrine action); dermal and epidermal units · PMID 11041445 · Erratum 2002. Also cited by A&RE ch.7 for the estrogen–senescence statement, which this 2000 review does not address (see findings).
note.es-MX: revisión narrativa · académica · rol: ref. 3 del cap. 5, ref. 3 del cap. 6, ref. 4 del cap. 7 de A&RE — la CRH, la POMC, la ACTH, la α-MSH y la β-endorfina se sintetizan en la piel junto con sus receptores (acción para/autocrina); unidades dérmica y epidérmica · PMID 11041445 · Fe de erratas 2002. También citada por el cap. 7 de A&RE para la afirmación sobre estrógeno y senescencia, la cual esta revisión del año 2000 no aborda (ver hallazgos).

citations.title: The human skin as a hormone target and an endocrine gland

note.en: narrative review · academic · role: A&RE ch.5 ref 4, ch.7 ref 2 — skin makes, activates and releases hormones, including sex steroids that matter for the whole organism, especially in older people · PMID 16982574 · Verified; no PMCID.
note.es-MX: revisión narrativa · académica · rol: ref. 4 del cap. 5, ref. 2 del cap. 7 de A&RE — la piel produce, activa y libera hormonas, incluidos esteroides sexuales de relevancia para todo el organismo, especialmente en personas de edad avanzada · PMID 16982574 · Verificado; sin PMCID.

citations.title: Neuronal control of skin function: the skin as a neuroimmunoendocrine organ
citations.authors: Roosterman D, Goerge T, Schneider SW, Bunnett NW, Steinhoff M

note.en: narrative review · academic · role: A&RE ch.5 ref 13 — sensory nerves and neuropeptides as the neural arm of the skin's signalling network · PMID 17015491 · Verified.
note.es-MX: revisión narrativa · académica · rol: ref. 13 del cap. 5 de A&RE — nervios sensoriales y neuropéptidos como el brazo neural de la red de señalización cutánea · PMID 17015491 · Verificado.

citations.title: Steroidogenesis in the skin: implications for local immune functions
citations.authors: Slominski A, Zbytek B, Nikolakis G, et al.

note.en: narrative review · academic · role: A&RE ch.6 ref 4 — skin cells hold the full apparatus (CYP11A1 onward) to make glucocorticoids, androgens and estrogens or activate circulating precursors; the review also describes a skin contribution to circulating androgens and estrogens · PMID 23435015 · Verified.
note.es-MX: revisión narrativa · académica · rol: ref. 4 del cap. 6 de A&RE — las células cutáneas poseen toda la maquinaria (a partir de CYP11A1) para sintetizar glucocorticoides, andrógenos y estrógenos o para activar precursores circulantes; la revisión también describe una contribución cutánea a los andrógenos y estrógenos circulantes · PMID 23435015 · Verificado.

citations.title: Keratinocytes control skin immune homeostasis through de novo-synthesized glucocorticoids
citations.authors: Phan TS, Schink L, Mann J, et al.

note.en: mouse genetic model (keratinocyte Cyp11b1 deletion) plus human disease association · academic · role: A&RE ch.6 ref 5 — keratinocyte-made glucocorticoids restrain skin inflammation; the functional proof is in mice · PMID 33514551 · The guide presents this without naming the species; the course labels it as animal evidence.
note.es-MX: modelo genético murino (deleción de Cyp11b1 en queratinocitos) más asociación con enfermedad humana · académica · rol: ref. 5 del cap. 6 de A&RE — los glucocorticoides producidos por queratinocitos frenan la inflamación cutánea; la prueba funcional es en ratones · PMID 33514551 · La guía presenta esto sin nombrar la especie; el curso lo etiqueta como evidencia animal.

citations.title: Human hair follicles display a functional equivalent of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis and synthesize cortisol
citations.authors: Ito N, Ito T, Kromminga A, et al.

note.en: human scalp hair follicles in organ culture (ex vivo) · academic · role: A&RE ch.6 ref 11 — CRH → POMC/ACTH → cortisol secretion with glucocorticoid feedback on CRH, in follicles with no systemic connections · PMID 15946990 · Verified.
note.es-MX: folículos pilosos de piel cabelluda humana en cultivo de órganos (ex vivo) · académica · rol: ref. 11 del cap. 6 de A&RE — CRH → POMC/ACTH → secreción de cortisol con retroalimentación de glucocorticoides sobre la CRH, en folículos sin conexiones sistémicas · PMID 15946990 · Verificado.

citations.title: Human Hair Follicles Operate a Functional Peripheral Equivalent of the Hypothalamic-Pituitary-Somatotropic Axis Ex Vivo
citations.authors: Horesh EJ, Gherardini J, Alam M, et al.

note.en: research letter; human follicles ex vivo · academic · role: A&RE ch.6 ref 12 — a GH/IGF-1 loop in the follicle · PMID 36496194 · No abstract indexed and not open access; cited only for the finding its title states.
note.es-MX: carta científica; folículos humanos ex vivo · académica · rol: ref. 12 del cap. 6 de A&RE — un bucle GH/IGF-1 en el folículo · PMID 36496194 · Sin resumen indexado y no es de acceso abierto; se cita únicamente por el hallazgo que indica su título.

citations.title: Thyroid hormone action in epidermal development and homeostasis and its implications in the pathophysiology of the skin
citations.authors: Mancino G, Miro C, Di Cicco E, Dentice M

note.en: narrative review (mouse models of thyroid-hormone metabolism) · academic · role: A&RE ch.6 ref 7 — local deiodinase control of T3 in keratinocytes; the review says the mechanisms are being clarified mainly in mouse models · PMID 33683663 · Verified.
note.es-MX: revisión narrativa (modelos murinos del metabolismo de hormonas tiroideas) · académica · rol: ref. 7 del cap. 6 de A&RE — control local de T3 por desyodasas en queratinocitos; la revisión señala que los mecanismos se están esclareciendo principalmente en modelos murinos · PMID 33683663 · Verificado.

citations.title: Photosynthesis of previtamin D3 in human skin and the physiologic consequences
citations.authors: Holick MF, MacLaughlin JA, Clark MB, et al.

note.en: human skin photobiology · academic · role: the skin-to-body example: previtamin D3 forms in human skin under solar UV and vitamin D3 is carried into the circulation by vitamin D-binding protein · PMID 6251551 · Not cited by either guide; added as the primary for the statement that skin supplies a whole-body hormone system.
note.es-MX: fotobiología de la piel humana · académica · rol: el ejemplo de la piel hacia el cuerpo: la previtamina D3 se forma en la piel humana bajo radiación UV solar y la vitamina D3 es transportada a la circulación mediante la proteína de unión a la vitamina D · PMID 6251551 · No citada por ninguna de las dos guías; agregada como fuente primaria para la afirmación de que la piel abastece un sistema hormonal para todo el organismo.

citations.title: Vitamin D metabolism, mechanism of action, and clinical applications

note.en: narrative review · academic · role: A&RE ch.7 ref 3 — vitamin D3 made in skin from 7-dehydrocholesterol, then 25(OH)D and 1,25(OH)2D elsewhere · PMID 24529992 · Verified.
note.es-MX: revisión narrativa · académica · rol: ref. 3 del cap. 7 de A&RE — la vitamina D3 se sintetiza en la piel a partir de 7-deshidrocolesterol, y posteriormente se convierte en 25(OH)D y 1,25(OH)2D en otros sitios · PMID 24529992 · Verificado.

citations.title: Thyroid hormone action on skin

note.en: clinical review · academic · role: A&RE ch.5 ref 8 — the skin signs of thyroid disease (myxoedema; dry, coarse skin) · PMID 22110782 · Verified (a 2012 review with the same title exists, PMID 22914563; the guide's volume and pages match this one).
note.es-MX: revisión clínica · académica · rol: ref. 8 del cap. 5 de A&RE — manifestaciones cutáneas de la enfermedad tiroidea (mixedema; piel seca y áspera) · PMID 22110782 · Verificado (existe una revisión de 2012 con el mismo título, PMID 22914563; el volumen y las páginas de la guía coinciden con esta).

citations.title: A Hormone Cell Atlas maps the human endocrine system at cellular resolution
citations.authors: Fei L, Huang-Doran I, Lawler K, et al. (senior authors Teichmann SA, Farooqi IS)

note.en: single-cell and single-nucleus transcriptomic atlas (hormone2cell): 379 hormone and receptor genes, ~14 million cells and nuclei, 47 human tissues · academic (University of Cambridge, Wellcome Sanger Institute) · role: A&RE ch.7 ref 1 — predicted hormone-producing and hormone-receiving cell types; the transcriptomic map the lesson is about · PMID 42207862 · PubMed entry 2026-05-28 (the guide's 'published online May 28, 2026'); print issue 2 Jul 2026. Full text and supplement paywalled (HTTP 403); only abstract- and portal-level facts are taught.
note.es-MX: atlas transcriptómico unicelular y uninuclear (hormone2cell): 379 genes de hormonas y receptores, ~14 millones de células y núcleos, 47 tejidos humanos · académica (Universidad de Cambridge, Wellcome Sanger Institute) · rol: ref. 1 del cap. 7 de A&RE — tipos celulares previstos productores de hormonas y receptores de hormonas; el mapa transcriptómico sobre el que trata la lección · PMID 42207862 · Entrada en PubMed 2026-05-28 ('publicado en línea el 28 de mayo de 2026' según la guía); edición impresa del 2 de jul de 2026. Texto completo y suplemento bajo muro de pago (HTTP 403); únicamente se enseñan datos a nivel de resumen y portal.

citations.title: Hormone Cell Atlas portal — About and FAQs
citations.authors: Hormone Cell Atlas team (Farooqi and Teichmann groups)

note.en: data portal · atlas authors · role: the authors' own usage statement: predictions are 'putative and hypothesis-generating, rather than … functional hormones and receptors', validation is the user's responsibility; 47 disease-free tissues, 1,900+ cell types, 14 million+ cells; skin is listed among the tissues on the sister cellxgene site (hormonecellatlas.cellgeni.sanger.ac.uk) · Fetched live 2026-09-24 (HTTP 200).
note.es-MX: portal de datos · autores del atlas · rol: declaración de uso de los propios autores: las predicciones son 'presuntivas y generadoras de hipótesis, más que … hormonas y receptores funcionales', la validación es responsabilidad del usuario; 47 tejidos libres de enfermedad, más de 1,900 tipos celulares, más de 14 millones de células; la piel figura entre los tejidos en el sitio hermano cellxgene (hormonecellatlas.cellgeni.sanger.ac.uk) · Consultado en vivo el 2026-09-24 (HTTP 200).

citations.title: On the Dependency of Cellular Protein Levels on mRNA Abundance
citations.authors: Liu Y, Beyer A, Aebersold R

note.en: narrative review · academic · role: transcript levels by themselves are not sufficient to predict protein levels in many scenarios · PMID 27104977 · Not cited by either guide; added to support the RNA-versus-protein step.

citations.title: The effect of sunscreen on vitamin D: a review

note.es-MX: revisión sistemática (MOOSE): 4 estudios experimentales, 3 ensayos de campo (2 ECA), 69 estudios observacionales · ámbito académico (QIMR Berghofer, Australian National University) · función: evalúa la perla clínica de la guía sobre la disminución de la 25(OH)D sérica con el uso de protector solar: los experimentos con radiación UV artificial muestran un bloqueo; los ensayos de campo aleatorizados con protector solar diario (FPS ~16) no muestran disminución; no se probaron productos con FPS alto · PMID 30945275 · No citada por ninguna de las dos guías; contradice la perla de evaluación del cap. 7 de A&RE (ver hallazgos).

citations.authors: Coppé JP, Patil CK, Rodier F, et al.

citations.title: p16INK4A is a robust in vivo biomarker of cellular aging in human skin

note.es-MX: banco de tejidos de piel humana, transversal (0–20, 21–70, 71–95 años) · ámbito académico · función: las células p16 positivas son más numerosas en la piel de mayor edad, tanto en la epidermis como en la dermis · PMID 16911562 · No citada por ninguna de las dos guías.

citations.title: P16INK4a Positive Cells in Human Skin Are Indicative of Local Elastic Fiber Morphology, Facial Wrinkling, and Perceived Age
citations.authors: Waaijer ME, Gunn DA, Adams PD, et al.

citations.title: Faces of cellular senescence in skin aging

citations.title: Biomarkers of Cellular Senescence and Skin Aging

citations.title: Targeting cellular senescence in dermatology: senolytic and senomorphic strategies

citations.title: The influence of age and sex on skin thickness, skin collagen and density

citations.title: Decreased collagen production in chronologically aged skin: roles of age-dependent alteration in fibroblast function and defective mechanical stimulation
citations.authors: Varani J, Dame MK, Rittie L, et al.

note.en: human skin sections (18–29 vs 80+ years) and isolated dermal fibroblasts · academic · role: aged fibroblasts make less procollagen and are less attached to and stretched by collagen — two routes to lower synthesis · PMID 16723701 · Not cited by either guide.

citations.title: Collagen fragmentation promotes oxidative stress and elevates matrix metalloproteinase-1 in fibroblasts in aged human skin
citations.authors: Fisher GJ, Quan T, Purohit T, et al.

note.en: aged (>80) vs young (21–30) human skin in vivo, plus organ and collagen-lattice culture · academic · role: more fibroblast MMP-1 in aged human dermis; fragmented collagen lowers fibroblast stretch and raises MMP-1 and oxidants — a self-perpetuating loop · PMID 19116368 · Not cited by either guide.

citations.title: Mechanisms of photoaging and chronological skin aging
citations.authors: Fisher GJ, Kang S, Varani J, et al.

citations.title: Naturally occurring p16(Ink4a)-positive cells shorten healthy lifespan
citations.authors: Baker DJ, Childs BG, Durik M, et al.

citations.title: Topical rapamycin reduces markers of senescence and aging in human skin: an exploratory, prospective, randomized trial
citations.authors: Chung CL, Lawrence I, Hoffman M, et al.

citations.title: Improvement of naturally aged skin with vitamin A (retinol)
citations.authors: Kafi R, Kwak HS, Schumacher WE, et al.

citations.title: Vitamin A antagonizes decreased cell growth and elevated collagen-degrading matrix metalloproteinases and stimulates collagen accumulation in naturally aged human skin

citations.title: Oral 11β-HSD1 inhibitor AZD4017 improves wound healing and skin integrity in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus: a pilot randomized controlled trial

citations.title: The diagnosis of Cushing's syndrome: an Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline
citations.authors: Nieman LK, Biller BMK, Findling JW, et al.

note.en: clinical practice guideline (GRADE) · professional society (Endocrine Society) · role: A&RE ch.8 ref 5. Table 1: features that best discriminate Cushing's syndrome = easy bruising, facial plethora, proximal myopathy, striae (especially reddish-purple and >1 cm wide); common and/or less discriminatory = facial fullness, dorsocervical fat pad, supraclavicular fullness, weight gain, obesity, acne, hirsutism, thin skin, fatigue, insomnia. 3.1 drug history first (oral, rectal, inhaled, topical, injected; skin creams incl. bleaching agents, herbal tonics, joint or nerve injections). 3.2 test multiple and progressive features or features unusual for age. 3.3 against widespread testing. 3.5 against random serum cortisol. Abnormal result → endocrinologist. Endogenous incidence 2–3 per million per year (European population studies); commonest cause iatrogenic. · PMID 18334580 · full text read at pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov (PMC2386281) 2026-09-24; test names only, doses not reproduced
note.es-MX: guía de práctica clínica (GRADE) · sociedad profesional (Endocrine Society) · función: A&RE cap. 8 ref. 5. Tabla 1: características que mejor discriminan el síndrome de Cushing = propensión a hematomas, plétora facial, miopatía proximal, estrías (especialmente violáceas y >1 cm de ancho); comunes o menos discriminatorias = redondez facial, giba dorsocervical, plenitud supraclavicular, aumento de peso, obesidad, acné, hirsutismo, piel adelgazada, fatiga, insomnio. 3.1 anamnesis farmacológica primero (oral, rectal, inhalada, tópica, inyectada; cremas para la piel incluidos agentes despigmentantes, tónicos herbales, infiltraciones articulares o perineurales). 3.2 evaluar ante múltiples características y progresivas o inusuales para la edad. 3.3 en contra del tamizaje indiscriminado. 3.5 en contra del cortisol sérico aleatorio. Resultado anormal → endocrinólogo. Incidencia endógena de 2–3 por millón al año (estudios de población europea); causa más frecuente: iatrogénica. · PMID 18334580 · texto completo consultado en pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov (PMC2386281) el 24-09-2026; solo nombres de pruebas, dosis no reproducidas

citations.title: Estrogens and aging skin

note.en: regulator guidance note · regulator · role: UK specials: the regulation 167 exemption is narrowly drawn because specials may not have been assessed for safety, quality and efficacy (1.5); an unlicensed product should not be supplied where an equivalent licensed product can meet the patient's special needs, and 'special need' excludes cost, convenience or operational needs (2.2–2.3); a UK-licensed product, even off-label, should be used before an unlicensed one (2.4); manufacturers need a Manufacturer's 'Specials' Licence and GMP-inspected sites (4.1); particular specials must not be advertised (7.1); products prepared in a pharmacy under section 10 are also unlicensed medicines (1.6); Appendix 2 hierarchy: UK licensed, then off-label, then imported licensed product, then UK special (GMP-inspected but otherwise unassessed), with products that are not medicines in their country of origin, such as supplements, least acceptable · Fetched live and read 2026-09-25 (HTTP 200). note.en: regulator guidance note · regulator · role: UK borderline classification: MHRA decides case by case whether a product is a medicinal product from all explicit and implicit claims (including websites, social media and testimonials), its presentation and product form (capsule, tablet, injection) and the way it is to be used (limb one), and its function (limb two); unless exempt a medicine must hold a UK marketing authorisation; cosmetics definition and the exclusion of anything ingested, inhaled, injected or implanted; any claim that a food prevents, treats or cures disease is not permitted, and only health claims authorised on the GB nutrition and health claims register may be used; defines a food supplement per the Food Supplements (England) Regulations 2003 · Fetched live and read 2026-09-25 (HTTP 200). PDF read in the sections used (classification factors, cosmetics, food and food claims).
note.es-MX: nota de orientación regulatoria · entidad regulatoria · función: clasificación de productos frontera en el Reino Unido: la MHRA decide caso por caso si un producto es un medicamento a partir de todas las declaraciones explícitas e implícitas (incluidos sitios web, redes sociales y testimonios), su presentación y forma farmacéutica o del producto (cápsula, tableta, inyección) y la vía de administración prevista (primer elemento), así como su función (segundo elemento); a menos que esté exento, un medicamento debe contar con una autorización de comercialización en el Reino Unido; definición de cosméticos y exclusión de cualquier sustancia ingerida, inhalada, inyectada o implantada; no se permite ninguna afirmación de que un alimento previene, trata o cura enfermedades, y únicamente pueden utilizarse las declaraciones de propiedades saludables autorizadas en el registro de declaraciones nutricionales y de propiedades saludables de Gran Bretaña; define un suplemento alimenticio conforme a las Food Supplements (England) Regulations 2003 · Obtenido en tiempo real y leído el 25-09-2026 (HTTP 200). PDF leído en las secciones utilizadas (factores de clasificación, cosméticos, alimentos y declaraciones sobre alimentos).

citations.title: Hair follicle immune privilege and its collapse in alopecia areata
citations.authors: Bertolini M, McElwee K, Gilhar A, Bulfone-Paus S, Paus R

note.en: narrative review (human ex vivo and animal-model evidence) · academic · role: anagen follicles are immune-privileged (low MHC antigen presentation, CD200 'no danger' signals); collapse is a prerequisite for alopecia areata, with NKG2D+ CD8 T-cell and NK-cell infiltration · PMID 32682334 · added from the literature (the guide states the idea without a review reference)
note.es-MX: revisión narrativa (evidencia ex vivo en humanos y modelos animales) · académica · función: los folículos en fase anágena gozan de privilegio inmunitario (baja presentación de antígenos por MHC, señales de «no peligro» por CD200); su colapso es un prerrequisito para la alopecia areata, con infiltración de células T CD8+ NKG2D+ y células NK · PMID 32682334 · añadido a partir de la literatura (la guía plantea el concepto sin una referencia de revisión)

note.es-MX: dos ensayos fase 3 aleatorizados y controlados con placebo (BRAVE-AA1 n=654, BRAVE-AA2 n=546); criterio de valoración principal SALT ≤20 en la semana 36 · industria (financiado por Eli Lilly bajo licencia de Incyte) · función: A&RE cap. 6 ref. 13 — 38.8 % / 35.9 % con la dosis más alta frente a 6.2 % / 3.3 % con placebo alcanzaron un SALT ≤20; el ejemplo con nivel de aprobación de evidencia folicular · PMID 35334197 · A&RE cap. 6 ref. 13; verificado

citations.title: Good practice in proposing, prescribing, providing and managing medicines and devices — Prescribing unlicensed medicines (paragraphs 102–108)
citations.publication: gmc-uk.org · in effect 5 April 2021, updated 15 March 2022 and 13 December 2024

note.en: professional standard · statutory professional regulator · role: UK doctors: GMC uses 'unlicensed medicine' for medicines used outside their UK licence or with no UK licence (102); usually prescribe licensed medicines within their licence (103); when prescribing an unlicensed medicine, be satisfied there is sufficient evidence or experience of safety and efficacy, take responsibility for prescribing and for overseeing care, monitoring and follow-up, and record the reasons where not following common practice (105); explain to the patient, with reasons, when use is not routine or licensed alternatives exist (108) · Read in a browser 2026-09-25; gmc-uk.org answers scripts with HTTP 403, so the automated source check cannot read it.
note.es-MX: estándar profesional · organismo regulador estatutario de la profesión · función: médicos en el Reino Unido: el GMC utiliza el término «medicamento no autorizado» (unlicensed medicine) para medicamentos utilizados fuera de su autorización de comercialización en el Reino Unido o que carecen de ella (102); por lo general, deben prescribir medicamentos autorizados dentro de su indicación aprobada (103); al prescribir un medicamento no autorizado, deben asegurarse de que exista suficiente evidencia o experiencia sobre su seguridad y eficacia, asumir la responsabilidad de la prescripción y de la supervisión de la atención, el monitoreo y el seguimiento, y registrar los motivos cuando no sigan la práctica común (105); explicar al paciente, con las razones correspondientes, cuando el uso no sea de rutina o existan alternativas autorizadas (108) · Leído en un navegador el 25-09-2026; gmc-uk.org responde a los scripts con HTTP 403, por lo que la verificación automatizada de fuentes no puede leerlo.

note.en: professional standard · statutory professional regulator · role: UK pharmacist prescribers: a pharmacist independent prescriber may prescribe any medicine for any condition within their scope and competence (exceptions: three controlled drugs for addiction and initiating unlicensed cannabis-based products); for an unlicensed or off-label medicine they must be sure of sufficient evidence and experience of its safety and effectiveness, and record discussions and the reasons for prescribing decisions · Fetched live and read 2026-09-25 (HTTP 200). note.en: advertising code · self-regulatory body backed by statutory referral · role: UK advertising: objective claims must be backed by evidence, where relevant trials on people (12.1); medicines must hold a licence before they are marketed (12.11); prescription-only medicines or prescription-only medical treatments may not be advertised to the public (12.12) · Fetched live and read 2026-09-25 (HTTP 200).

note.en: regulator guidance · regulator · role: UK advertising: medicinal products without a valid licence may not be advertised (regulation 279, s. 4.2); specials suppliers may not advertise specific unlicensed products; clinics may promote their service, e.g. 'treatment for lines and wrinkles', but must not name prescription-only products such as 'Botox' (s. 7.3); in treatment-service websites and social media, unlicensed medicines should not be mentioned, treatments using them may not be called 'clinically proven', and naming a prescription-only medicine in a clinic's social media is likely to be a prohibited advertisement (Appendix 6) · Fetched live and read 2026-09-25 (HTTP 200). note.es-MX: guía del organismo regulador · organismo regulador · función: publicidad en el Reino Unido: no se pueden publicitar medicamentos que carezcan de una autorización comercial válida (reglamento 279, sec. 4.2); los proveedores de preparados especiales («specials») no pueden publicitar productos no autorizados específicos; las clínicas pueden promocionar sus servicios, p. ej., «tratamiento para líneas de expresión y arrugas», pero no deben mencionar productos de prescripción médica por su nombre, como «Botox» (sec. 7.3); en sitios web y redes sociales de servicios de tratamiento no deben mencionarse medicamentos no autorizados, los tratamientos que los utilicen no pueden calificarse de «clínicamente comprobados», y nombrar un medicamento de venta bajo receta médica en las redes sociales de una clínica se considera probablemente publicidad prohibida (Apéndice 6) · Consultado en vivo y leído el 25-09-2026 (HTTP 200). claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "“Os peptídeos bioativos de colágeno hidrolisado com peso molecular médio de 2 kDa auxiliam na manutenção da saúde da pele.”" (English: "“Bioactive hydrolysed collagen peptides with an average molecular weight of 2 kDa help maintain skin health.”") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, a compounded (magistral) preparation must be made individually by the pharmacy against a prescription from an authorised professional that sets its composition, form and dosing (RDC 96/2008 definition).
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "PREPARAÇÃO MAGISTRAL - É aquela preparada na farmácia, de forma individualizada, para ser dispensada atendendo a uma prescrição de um profissional habilitado, respeitada a legislação vigente, que estabelece sua composição, forma farmacêutica, posologia e modo de usar." (English: "MAGISTRAL PREPARATION – One prepared in the pharmacy, individually, to be dispensed against a prescription from an authorised professional, in accordance with current legislation, which sets its composition, dosage form, dosing and directions for use.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, ANVISA stated on 2 Jul 2026 that any substance must have undergone efficacy and safety assessment before it can be compounded, and that compounding may only be individual, on a medical prescription, by a compounding pharmacy licensed by local health surveillance.
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "Para ser manipulada, qualquer substância precisa ter passado por análises de eficácia e segurança. Além disso, a manipulação de qualquer fórmula SÓ pode ocorrer de forma individualizada, com apresentação de receita médica, por farmácias de manipulação que estejam devidamente regularizadas na vigilância sanitária local." (English: "To be compounded, any substance must have undergone efficacy and safety assessments. In addition, compounding of any formula may ONLY take place individually, on presentation of a medical prescription, by compounding pharmacies duly licensed by local health surveillance.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, ANVISA stated in Nov 2024 that compounded medicines should be used only when the registered industrial product is unavailable in the dose or dosage form the patient needs, and that only APIs with a current or past registration may be compounded into hormonal implants.
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "A Anvisa ressalta que medicamentos manipulados devem ser utilizados somente diante da indisponibilidade do produto industrializado, registrado na Agência, na dosagem ou forma farmacêutica específica necessária ao paciente, e a partir de avaliação e da prescrição do profissional médico responsável." (English: "Anvisa stresses that compounded medicines should be used only when the industrialised product registered with the Agency is unavailable in the specific dose or dosage form the patient needs, and following assessment and prescription by the responsible physician.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, Nota Técnica 200/2025 (Aug 2025) allows compounding of GLP-1 agonists only in narrow conditions: synthetic APIs only if a registered medicine with the same molecule exists, biotech APIs only from the manufacturer assessed at registration, with mandatory quality testing; at that date synthetic semaglutide could not be imported or compounded.
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "No caso dos IFAs obtidos por síntese química, a manipulação é permitida desde que já existam medicamentos registrados no Brasil com a mesma molécula. … Por exemplo, atualmente, a semaglutida possui registro apenas como produto biotecnológico. Portanto, não é permitida a importação nem a manipulação da semaglutida sintética até que exista um medicamento registrado com o IFA sintético." (English: "For APIs obtained by chemical synthesis, compounding is permitted provided registered medicines with the same molecule already exist in Brazil. … For example, semaglutide is currently registered only as a biotechnological product. Therefore, import and compounding of synthetic semaglutide are not permitted until a medicine with the synthetic API is registered.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, ANVISA stated in Apr 2025 that its measure does not change the physician's right to prescribe medicines for purposes other than those on the label (off-label use), when the physician considers that, for a given patient, the benefits outweigh the risks.
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "A medida não altera o direito do profissional médico de prescrever medicamentos para finalidades diferentes das descritas na bula. Essa prática, conhecida como uso "off label", acontece quando o médico entende que, para determinado paciente, os benefícios do tratamento superam os riscos." (English: "The measure does not change the physician's right to prescribe medicines for purposes other than those described in the label. This practice, known as "off-label" use, occurs when the physician considers that, for a given patient, the benefits of treatment outweigh the risks.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, no medicine, including an imported one, may be manufactured, sold or supplied before it is registered (Law 6.360/1976, art. 12).
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "Art. 12 - Nenhum dos produtos de que trata esta Lei, inclusive os importados, poderá ser industrializado, exposto à venda ou entregue ao consumo antes de registrado no Ministério da Saúde." (English: "Art. 12 – None of the products covered by this Law, including imported ones, may be manufactured, offered for sale or supplied for consumption before being registered with the Ministry of Health.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

(English: "Not surprisingly, some injectable peptides are NOT regularised with the National Health Surveillance Agency (Anvisa) in any category – food, medicine, cosmetic, food supplement – that is, they are ILLEGAL for any health use, including aesthetic use.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, ANVISA stated in Jul 2026 that an investigational (experimental) medicine is used exclusively in authorised clinical research.

claims.text: In Brazil, unregistered medicines may be imported only exceptionally, for strictly personal use, with a medical prescription; when ANVISA publishes a specific prohibition (as for several GLP-1 pens in 2025–2026), import by any route is suspended.
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "Medicamentos sem registro no Brasil só podem ser importados de forma excepcional e para uso exclusivamente pessoal, mediante prescrição médica e o cumprimento de requisitos adicionais. (English: "Medicines without registration in Brazil may only be imported exceptionally and for exclusively personal use, on medical prescription and subject to additional requirements. However, where Anvisa publishes a specific prohibition, import by any route is also suspended.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, ANVISA stated in Sep 2025 that use of an unregistered imported medicine is entirely the responsibility of the patient and the prescribing physician.

Seu uso é de inteira responsabilidade do paciente e do médico prescritor, além do risco de falsificação no mercado internacional." (English: "Another warning: medicines without registration in Brazil have not had their safety and efficacy assessed by the Agency. claims.text: In Brazil, cosmetic labelling may not carry therapeutic claims for the product or its ingredients (RDC 907/2024, art. 12), so a peptide serum that claims to treat a condition falls outside the cosmetic category.
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "Art. 12. A rotulagem não deve conter nome comercial, marcas, imagens, links eletrônicos ou dizeres que: … II - representem alegações terapêuticas atribuídas ao uso do produto ou de seus ingredientes" (English: "Art. 12. Labelling must not contain trade names, brands, images, electronic links or wording that: … II – represent therapeutic claims attributed to the use of the product or its ingredients") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, ANVISA stated on 2 Jul 2026 that injectable cosmetics do not exist; an injectable product offered as a cosmetic is irregular. Topical products named after GHK-Cu do appear as notified cosmetics in ANVISA's cosmetics dataset (221 entries, 25 Sep 2026); ANVISA cancelled several GHK-Cu cosmetic processes on 29 Apr 2026 without published reasons (RE 1.771/2026).
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "Por fim, apesar de suposta finalidade estética, esses produtos também NÃO são cosméticos. Não existem cosméticos injetáveis e, se o produto é oferecido desta forma, trata-se de cosmético irregular." (English: "Finally, despite their supposed aesthetic purpose, these products are also NOT cosmetics. Injectable cosmetics do not exist and, if the product is offered in this form, it is an irregular cosmetic.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, a food supplement is by definition a product for oral ingestion for healthy people (RDC 243/2018), so no injectable supplement can exist.
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "VII - suplemento alimentar: produto para ingestão oral, apresentado em formas farmacêuticas, destinado a suplementar a alimentação de indivíduos saudáveis com nutrientes, substâncias bioativas, enzimas ou probióticos, isolados ou combinados." (English: "VII – food supplement: a product for oral ingestion, presented in pharmaceutical forms, intended to supplement the diet of healthy individuals with nutrients, bioactive substances, enzymes or probiotics, alone or combined.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, the constituents a food supplement may use are those on ANVISA's authorised list (IN 28/2018); constituents not on the list must not be used.
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "Os constituintes autorizados constam da lista aprovada na IN 28/2018 e são diferentes para os seguintes grupos etários: 0 a 3 anos (Anexo II) e acima de 3 anos (Anexo I). … Constituintes que não constem dessa lista não devem ser utilizados." (English: "Authorised constituents are on the list approved in IN 28/2018 and differ for the following age groups: 0 to 3 years (Annex II) and over 3 years (Annex I). … Constituents not on this list must not be used.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, promotion of prescription-only medicines is restricted to media aimed exclusively at professionals who can prescribe or dispense them, and online promotion must sit behind a registration wall for those professionals (RDC 96/2008, arts 27 and 29).

claims.text: In Brazil, compounding pharmacies may give only prescribers factual material naming active substances and referenced indications, with no brand names, prices or promotional content (RDC 96/2008, art. 36); ANVISA restated in Nov 2024 that advertising compounded products to the public is not permitted.

claims.text: In Brazil, since 23 Jun 2025 all GLP-1 agonist medicines (semaglutide, liraglutide, dulaglutide, tirzepatide and others), industrial or compounded, need a two-copy prescription valid 90 days that the pharmacy retains (RDC 973/2025 and IN 360/2025).

(English: "Normative Instruction IN 360 and Collegiate Board Resolution RDC 973 were published on 24 April 2025 and enter into force 60 (sixty) days after that date. Thus, the new measures on GLP-1 receptor agonists apply from 23 June 2025.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, the Federal Council of Medicine bars physicians from using anabolic steroids or androgens for aesthetic purposes or performance, and from prescribing hormones marketed as "bioidentical" or "nano" without proof of superiority (CFM Resolution 2.333/2023, in force since its publication on 11 Apr 2023; listed as in force on 25 Sep 2026).

(English: "Art. 3 The following procedures are prohibited in medical practice, lacking sufficient scientific proof of benefit and safety for humans, as are their use and promotion: … II – Use of formulations of anabolic steroids or androgenic hormones for aesthetic purposes; … IV – The prescription of hormones promoted as “bioidentical”, in “nano” formulation or under commercial names, without due scientific proof of clinical superiority for the purpose set out in this resolution.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

Utilização de hormônios, em qualquer formulação, inclusive o hormônio de crescimento, exceto nas situações de deficiências diagnosticadas cuja reposição mostra evidências de benefícios cientificamente comprovados;" (English: "III. claims.text: In Brazil, ANVISA inspections between Jan and Apr 2026 led to interdiction of 8 of the 26 compounding pharmacies and importers assessed and seized over 1.3 million irregular injectable units; ANVISA and the Federal Police issued a joint technical note on 6 May 2026 on crimes involving irregular GLP-1 medicines.

(English: "Inspections by Anvisa between January and April led to the closure of 8 of the 26 establishments assessed, as well as the seizure of more than 1.3 million units of irregular injectable medicines and more than 11 prohibition measures on the import, trade and use of these products.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: Under EU law a product is a medicine by presentation (presented as treating or preventing disease) or by function (restoring, correcting or modifying physiological functions by a pharmacological, immunological or metabolic action), and where a product could be both a medicine and another regulated product, medicines law applies (Directive 2001/83/EC, Articles 1(2) and 2(2)).
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "Any substance or combination of substances presented as having properties for treating or preventing disease in human beings; or … Any substance or combination of substances which may be used in or administered to human beings either with a view to restoring, correcting or modifying physiological functions by exerting a pharmacological, immunological or metabolic action, or to making a medical diagnosis. … In cases of doubt, where, taking into account all its characteristics, a product may fall within the definition of a ‘medicinal product’ and within the definition of a product covered by other Community legislation the provisions of this Directive shall apply." (English: "Any substance or combination of substances presented as having properties for treating or preventing disease in human beings; or … Any substance or combination of substances which may be used in or administered to human beings either with a view to restoring, correcting or modifying physiological functions by exerting a pharmacological, immunological or metabolic action, or to making a medical diagnosis. … In cases of doubt, where, taking into account all its characteristics, a product may fall within the definition of a ‘medicinal product’ and within the definition of a product covered by other Community legislation the provisions of this Directive shall apply.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: EU cosmetic claims must be supported by adequate and verifiable evidence, and a claim that extrapolates an ingredient's properties (for example a peptide's) to the finished product needs evidence such as the ingredient's presence at an effective concentration (Regulation (EU) No 655/2013).

(English: "Claims for cosmetic products, whether explicit or implicit, shall be supported by adequate and verifiable evidence regardless of the types of evidential support used to substantiate them, including where appropriate expert assessments. … A claim extrapolating (explicitly or implicitly) ingredient properties to the finished product shall be supported by adequate and verifiable evidence, such as by demonstrating the presence of the ingredient at an effective concentration.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Portugal, the health regulator ERS (Entidade Reguladora da Saúde) enforces the health-advertising rules, with fines of €250–€3,740.98 for individuals and €1,000–€44,891.81 for companies, plus possible bans of up to two years (Decreto-Lei 238/2015, Art 8).

claims.text: In Portugal, every medicine intended for parenteral administration (injection) is prescription-only by law (Estatuto do Medicamento, Art 114(1)(d)).

claims.text: In Portugal, 'restricted prescription' medicines (MSRM restrita) are reserved to specialised settings: alínea a) means exclusive hospital use (e.g., Olumiant, Scenesse) and alínea b) means conditions diagnosed only in hospital or specialised settings (e.g., somatropin) (Estatuto do Medicamento, Art 118).

units.tutorContext: Module 1 teaches cutaneous neuro-immuno-endocrine physiology with every finding labelled by evidence type (mechanism, human evidence, regulatory status, open question). The skin is described as four immuno-endocrine units (epidermal, dermal, hypodermal, adnexal) that signal locally, via sensory nerves and via the circulation (mechanism reviews, D). Skin cells express CYP11A1, 11β-HSD1, 5α-reductase and aromatase and make cortisol, DHT and estradiol locally (cell/tissue work, D); human scalp follicles run an HPA-like loop with cortisol secretion and CRH feedback ex vivo (Ito 2005) and a GH/IGF-1 loop ex vivo (Horesh 2023); keratinocyte glucocorticoids restrain skin inflammation in mice (Phan 2021); the thyroid-like loop is mostly mouse data. Three directions: local loop; body to skin (Cushing striae, hypothyroid skin); skin to body (vitamin D3 released into the circulation, established human physiology; a skin contribution to circulating sex steroids per reviews). Refer systemic patterns promptly (violaceous striae with new hypertension or diabetes, rapid virilisation), per the Aesthetic & Regenerative Endocrinology guide. The Hormone Cell Atlas (Fei, Huang-Doran et al., Science 2026) read RNA of 379 hormone/receptor genes in ~14 million cells and nuclei from 47 tissues incl. skin; its authors call the predictions putative and hypothesis-generating: RNA is not protein, secretion or clinical effect. The guide's pearl that serum 25(OH)D falls with sunscreen use is not borne out by field trials of daily moderate-SPF sunscreen (Neale 2019, C; high SPF untested); never advise dropping sun protection. Senescence: p16-positive cells rise with age in human epidermis and dermis (C) and track with wrinkles and perceived age (Waaijer 2016, n=178, association, C); the SASP was defined in cultured cells (D); an MMP-1 collagen-fragmentation loop is shown in aged human dermis plus culture (D), with senescent cells a plausible, unproven driver; clearing senescent cells extends healthy lifespan in mice (D); human senotherapy data are small biomarker pilots (Hickson 2019 open-label n=9, D; Chung 2019 topical rapamycin exploratory RCT, C); no randomized trial with clinical skin-ageing outcomes (checked Sept 2026); the guide confines senolytics to trials. Levers with human trials: daily sunscreen (Hughes 2013, n=903, B), topical tretinoin for photoageing (GRADE A), retinol in very old skin (Kafi 2007, C). Never give doses, concentrations, regimens or sourcing; adapt 'what you do next' to the learner's role (prescriber, clinical staff, advisor) without changing evidence. No CME credit is currently offered.

videoTranscript.en: This course starts with physiology, because every later question about a hormone or peptide for skin rests on it. Skin senses hormones from the blood, makes several of its own, and ages in ways that change both. Think of the skin as a sensing organ with its own hormone supply. Researchers who study it describe four units, epidermal, dermal, hypodermal and adnexal, the last meaning hair follicles and glands. Each unit holds cells that can make hormones and mount an immune response, such as keratinocytes, fibroblasts, sebocytes, fat cells and mast cells. Signals move three ways. Neighbouring cells talk directly, sensory nerves carry messages in and out, and some products enter the blood and reach distant organs. Keep one distinction in view for the whole module. A signal that is made and used inside the skin is a local loop. A hormone that arrives from the blood, or leaves the skin for the rest of the body, is systemic signalling.
videoTranscript.es-MX: Este curso comienza con la fisiología, ya que de ella depende cualquier pregunta posterior sobre una hormona o péptido para la piel. La piel detecta hormonas de la sangre, sintetiza varias propias y envejece de maneras que alteran ambos procesos. Considere a la piel como un órgano sensorial con su propio aporte hormonal. Los investigadores que la estudian describen cuatro unidades: epidérmica, dérmica, hipodérmica y anexial; esta última comprende los folículos pilosos y las glándulas. Cada unidad alberga células capaces de producir hormonas y montar una respuesta inmunitaria, como queratinocitos, fibroblastos, sebocitos, adipocitos y mastocitos. Las señales se desplazan por tres vías: las células vecinas se comunican directamente, los nervios sensitivos transportan mensajes de entrada y salida, y algunos productos pasan a la sangre y alcanzan órganos distantes. Mantenga presente una distinción a lo largo de todo el módulo: una señal producida y utilizada dentro de la piel constituye un circuito local; una hormona que llega desde la sangre, o que sale de la piel hacia el resto del cuerpo, corresponde a señalización sistémica.

body.en: Recent reviews describe the skin as a neuro-immuno-endocrine organ built from four units: epidermal, dermal, hypodermal and adnexal (hair follicles and glands). Each holds cells that can make hormones and mount an immune response. They signal to neighbouring cells, through sensory nerves, and through the blood. Most of this picture comes from cell, tissue and animal studies.

Cada una contiene células capaces de sintetizar hormonas y montar una respuesta inmunitaria. Envían señales a células vecinas, a través de nervios sensitivos y por el torrente sanguíneo. La mayor parte de este panorama procede de estudios celulares, tisulares y en modelos animales.

audioScript.en: Think of the skin as a sensing organ with its own hormone supply. Researchers who study it describe four units, epidermal, dermal, hypodermal and adnexal, the last meaning hair follicles and glands. Each unit holds cells that can make hormones and mount an immune response, such as keratinocytes, fibroblasts, sebocytes, fat cells and mast cells. Signals move three ways. A signal that is made and used inside the skin is a local loop. A hormone that arrives from the blood, or leaves the skin for the rest of the body, is systemic signalling. imageBrief.prompt: A cross-section of human skin drawn as a clean rectangular block, showing its four units: a thin wavy epidermis on top; a thicker dermis of loose wavy collagen fibres with a few scattered cells; a bottom layer of rounded subcutaneous fat lobules; and the adnexa — one hair follicle running obliquely down through the dermis with a small sebaceous gland beside its upper part, and one coiled sweat gland low in the dermis. title.en: A steroid factory with local axes.
title.es-MX: Una fábrica de esteroides con ejes locales.

body.en: Skin cells carry the enzymes to build steroids from cholesterol or to activate precursors arriving in the blood, and they run shortened copies of the body's central hormone axes. Each row names the evidence it rests on, because most of it comes from cells, tissue kept alive outside the body, or mice.
body.es-MX: Las células cutáneas cuentan con las enzimas necesarias para sintetizar esteroides a partir del colesterol o para activar precursores provenientes de la circulación sanguínea, y operan versiones abreviadas de los ejes hormonales centrales del organismo. Cada fila detalla la evidencia en la que se sustenta, dado que la mayor parte procede de cultivos celulares, tejido mantenido ex vivo o modelos murinos.

body.en: Hormone signals in skin run in three directions. Some are made and used in the same patch of skin. Some arrive from the blood. A few leave the skin and act on the rest of the body. Knowing which one you are looking at decides whether the answer lies in the skin or in a systemic assessment.

Unas pocas salen de la piel y actúan en el resto del organismo. Saber ante cuál se encuentra determina si la respuesta reside en la piel o en una evaluación sistémica.

label.en: Keratinocytes make cortisol that restrains immune cells in the same patch of skin

why.en: Local loop. Made and used where it is produced; the functional proof comes from mice that cannot make it in keratinocytes and develop skin inflammation.
why.es-MX: Circuito local. Se sintetiza y se utiliza donde se produce; la prueba funcional proviene de ratones que no pueden sintetizarlo en los queratinocitos y desarrollan inflamación cutánea.

label.en: UVB turns 7-dehydrocholesterol into vitamin D3, which the blood carries to the liver
label.es-MX: La radiación UVB convierte el 7-deshidrocolesterol en vitamina D3, la cual es transportada por la sangre hacia el hígado

why.en: Skin to body. Vitamin D3 made in the skin is released into the circulation and activated elsewhere. Established human physiology.
why.es-MX: De la piel al cuerpo. La vitamina D3 producida en la piel se libera hacia la circulación y se activa en otros tejidos. Fisiología humana establecida.

label.en: Violaceous striae, thin skin and easy bruising in Cushing syndrome
label.es-MX: Estrías violáceas, piel adelgazada y propensión a equimosis en el síndrome de Cushing

why.en: Body to skin. Systemic cortisol excess acting on the dermis. The Aesthetic & Regenerative Endocrinology guide lists suspected Cushing syndrome as a reason to refer promptly.
why.es-MX: Del cuerpo a la piel. Exceso de cortisol sistémico que actúa sobre la dermis. La guía de Aesthetic & Regenerative Endocrinology incluye la sospecha de síndrome de Cushing como motivo de referencia oportuna.

label.en: Scalp hair follicles kept alive in culture secrete cortisol, then switch off their own CRH

why.en: Local loop, with its own feedback, running with no blood supply or nerves attached. Human tissue, ex vivo.
why.es-MX: Circuito local, con su propia retroalimentación, que funciona sin aporte vascular ni inervación. Tejido humano, ex vivo.

label.en: Skin converts circulating precursors into androgens and estrogens that add to the body's supply
label.es-MX: La piel convierte precursores circulantes en andrógenos y estrógenos que se suman a la reserva del organismo

why.en: Skin to body. Reviews describe a skin contribution to circulating sex steroids, more so in older people; the evidence is mainly biochemical.
why.es-MX: De la piel al cuerpo. Las revisiones describen una contribución cutánea a los esteroides sexuales circulantes, mayor en personas de edad avanzada; la evidencia es principalmente bioquímica.

label.en: Dry, coarse skin and myxoedema in hypothyroidism
label.es-MX: Piel seca y áspera y mixedema en el hipotiroidismo

why.en: Body to skin. Circulating thyroid hormone sets epidermal turnover and dermal matrix; the skin signs track the systemic deficit.
why.es-MX: Del cuerpo a la piel. La hormona tiroidea circulante regula el recambio epidérmico y la matriz dérmica; los signos cutáneos reflejan el déficit sistémico.

label.en: Scalp follicles convert testosterone to DHT, which shrinks susceptible follicles
label.es-MX: Los folículos de la piel cabelluda convierten testosterona en DHT, lo que miniaturiza los folículos susceptibles

why.en: Local loop. 5α-reductase in the pilosebaceous unit makes DHT where it acts; the guide names it the substrate of acne, androgenetic alopecia and hirsutism.

done.en: Seven placed. Three local loops, two signals the skin sends out, and two it receives.
done.es-MX: Siete clasificados. Tres circuitos locales, dos señales que la piel emite y dos que recibe.

title.en: Read the skin before the serum.
title.es-MX: Interprete la piel antes del suero cosmético.

body.en: The Aesthetic & Regenerative Endocrinology guide treats the aesthetic exam as a systemic screen. Sudden thinning and easy bruising suggest cortisol excess; coarse, dry, cool skin suggests hypothyroidism; new acanthosis nigricans flags insulin resistance. It lists violaceous striae with new hypertension or diabetes, and rapidly progressive virilisation, among reasons to refer promptly to endocrinology. Local skin biology explains how skin behaves; it does not justify prescribing a hormone.
body.es-MX: La guía de Endocrinología Estética y Regenerativa aborda la exploración estética como un tamizaje sistémico. El adelgazamiento cutáneo repentino y la propensión a equimosis sugieren exceso de cortisol; la piel áspera, seca y fría sugiere hipotiroidismo; la acantosis nigricans de nueva aparición señala resistencia a la insulina. Enumera las estrías violáceas acompañadas de hipertensión o diabetes de inicio reciente, así como la virilización rápidamente progresiva, entre las razones para derivar de inmediato a endocrinología. La biología cutánea local explica cómo se comporta la piel; no justifica la prescripción de una hormona.

points.en: A skin sign can be the first sign of a systemic disorder
points.es-MX: Un signo cutáneo puede ser la primera manifestación de un trastorno sistémico

points.en: Some patterns need prompt endocrine referral
points.es-MX: Algunos patrones requieren una derivación endocrinológica oportuna

points.en: Local loops explain biology; they do not justify treatment
points.es-MX: Los circuitos locales explican la biología; no justifican el tratamiento

blocks.sourceNote: Aesthetic & Regenerative Endocrinology, ch. 5 clinical pearl and referral list · Safer 2011

body.en: Thinning and bruising, coarse dry skin, new acanthosis nigricans: each points to a systemic axis before it points to a serum.
body.es-MX: Adelgazamiento y equimosis, piel áspera y seca, acantosis nigricans de nueva aparición: cada uno apunta a un eje sistémico antes que a un suero cosmético.

body.en: The guide lists violaceous striae with new hypertension or diabetes, rapid virilisation and signs of an endocrine tumour as reasons to refer promptly.

title.es-MX: El papel de la biología local

body.en: Local loops explain how skin behaves day to day. The guide calls them foundation, never a reason to dose anyone with a hormone.
body.es-MX: Los circuitos locales explican cómo se comporta la piel día a día. La guía los describe como fundamentos biológicos, nunca como una razón para administrar una hormona a alguien.

audioScript.en: Picture the consultation where a patient asks about thinning, bruising skin. The Aesthetic and Regenerative Endocrinology guide asks you to read that skin as a window on the whole endocrine system before reaching for a serum. Sudden thinning with easy bruising suggests cortisol excess. Coarse, dry, cool skin suggests an underactive thyroid. New acanthosis nigricans points to insulin resistance. The guide lists violaceous striae with new hypertension or diabetes, rapidly progressive virilisation, and signs of an endocrine tumour as reasons to refer promptly to endocrinology. The local loops from the last two moments explain how skin behaves day to day. They are foundation biology, and the guide is explicit that they are no rationale for dosing anyone with a hormone. Whatever your role, a systemic pattern in the skin gets a systemic answer.
audioScript.es-MX: Imagine la consulta en la que una paciente pregunta sobre el adelgazamiento de la piel y la aparición de equimosis. La guía de Endocrinología Estética y Regenerativa le pide interpretar esa piel como una ventana a todo el sistema endocrino antes de recurrir a un suero cosmético. El adelgazamiento repentino con facilidad para formar equimosis sugiere un exceso de cortisol. La piel áspera, seca y fría sugiere hipofunción tiroidea. La acantosis nigricans de nueva aparición apunta a resistencia a la insulina. La guía enumera las estrías violáceas con hipertensión o diabetes de inicio reciente, la virilización rápidamente progresiva y los signos de un tumor endocrino como razones para derivar de inmediato a endocrinología. Los circuitos locales de los dos momentos anteriores explican cómo se comporta la piel día a día. Son biología fundamental, y la guía es explícita en que no constituyen una justificación para prescribir una hormona a nadie. Cualquiera que sea su función, un patrón sistémico en la piel requiere una respuesta sistémica.

prescriber.en: When a skin pattern suggests a systemic disorder, assess or refer before any cosmetic plan, and record that you considered it. Local skin biology is no basis for prescribing a hormone for appearance.
prescriber.es-MX: Cuando un patrón cutáneo sugiera un trastorno sistémico, evalúe o derive antes de cualquier plan cosmético y registre en el expediente que lo consideró. La biología cutánea local no es una base para prescribir una hormona con fines estéticos.

clinical-staff.en: If you see new striae, rapid bruising, sudden hair change or signs of virilisation, record them and raise them with the prescriber before the next treatment.
clinical-staff.es-MX: Si observa estrías nuevas, equimosis de rápida aparición, cambios repentinos en el pelo o signos de virilización, regístrelos y coméntelos con el prescriptor antes del siguiente tratamiento.

advisor.en: If a client's skin change comes with new systemic symptoms, suggest they see a prescriber before trying another product. A serum cannot answer a systemic question.
advisor.es-MX: Si el cambio cutáneo de una paciente se acompaña de síntomas sistémicos nuevos, sugiérale consultar a un médico prescriptor antes de probar otro producto. Un suero cosmético no puede resolver una afección sistémica.

title.es-MX: «¿Qué suero cosmético me recomienda para mi piel seca?»

body.en: A fictional case in three decisions, built from this lesson's guidance.
body.es-MX: Un caso ficticio en tres decisiones, estructurado a partir de las pautas de esta lección.

blocks.sourceNote: Fictional case · Aesthetic & Regenerative Endocrinology, ch. 5–6 · Safer 2011 · Mancino 2021 · Slominski 2013

title.en: Dry skin, or a thyroid question?

prompt.en: Work through her visit one decision at a time.
prompt.es-MX: Aborde su consulta decisión por decisión.

setup.en: Fictional case. A 44-year-old asks which serum would help her skin. Over the past year it has become coarse, dry and cool.
setup.es-MX: Caso ficticio. Una paciente de 44 años pregunta qué suero cosmético le ayudaría para su piel. Durante el último año, esta se ha vuelto áspera, seca y fría.

prompt.en: What do you do first?
prompt.es-MX: ¿Qué hace primero?

label.en: Suggest a richer serum and see how her skin responds.
label.es-MX: Sugerir un suero más enriquecido y observar la respuesta de su piel.

why.en: That reaches for a serum first. The guide asks you to read the skin as a window on the whole endocrine system before reaching for a serum.
why.es-MX: Eso recurre primero a un suero. La guía le solicita interpretar la piel como una ventana a todo el sistema endocrino antes de recurrir a un suero cosmético.

label.en: Read the change as a possible sign of an underactive thyroid, before any product.
label.es-MX: Interpretar el cambio como un posible signo de hipofunción tiroidea, antes de indicar cualquier producto.

why.en: Right. Coarse, dry, cool skin suggests an underactive thyroid, and the guide treats the aesthetic exam as a systemic screen.
why.es-MX: Correcto. La piel áspera, seca y fría sugiere hipofunción tiroidea, y la guía aborda la exploración estética como un tamizaje sistémico.

label.en: Tell her dry skin is a problem for the skin alone.
label.es-MX: Decirle que la piel seca es un problema exclusivamente cutáneo.

why.en: A skin finding can be the visible sign of a systemic disorder, and knowing which way the signal runs decides whether the answer lies in the skin or in a systemic assessment.
why.es-MX: Un hallazgo cutáneo puede ser el signo visible de un trastorno sistémico, y comprender la dirección de la señal determina si la solución radica en la piel o en una evaluación sistémica.

prompt.en: Her skin suggests an underactive thyroid. What comes before any cosmetic plan?
prompt.es-MX: Su piel sugiere una hipofunción tiroidea. ¿Qué procede antes de cualquier plan cosmético?

label.en: A systemic answer: a prescriber assesses or refers her, and the discussion is recorded.
label.es-MX: Una respuesta sistémica: un médico prescriptor la evalúa o la deriva, y la conversación se asienta en el expediente.

why.en: Right. Whatever your role, a systemic pattern in the skin gets a systemic answer, before any cosmetic plan.
why.es-MX: Correcto. Cualquiera que sea su función, un patrón sistémico en la piel amerita una respuesta sistémica, antes de cualquier plan cosmético.

label.en: Start the serum now, and look at her thyroid only if it fails.
label.es-MX: Iniciar el suero ahora y evaluar la tiroides únicamente si este falla.

why.en: A serum cannot answer a systemic question. The pattern is assessed or referred before any cosmetic plan.
why.es-MX: Un suero cosmético no puede resolver una afección sistémica. El patrón debe evaluarse o derivarse antes de cualquier plan cosmético.

prompt.en: She has read that skin runs its own thyroid-like loop and asks for a cream to restore it. What do you tell her?
prompt.es-MX: Ha leído que la piel tiene su propio circuito tipo tiroideo y pide una crema para restaurarlo. ¿Qué le dice usted?

label.en: That a cream is reasonable alongside the assessment, because the loop is real.
label.es-MX: Que una crema es razonable junto con la evaluación, porque el circuito es real.

why.en: The guide is explicit that local loops are no rationale for dosing anyone with a hormone, and this one rests mostly on mouse models.
why.es-MX: La guía es explícita en que los circuitos locales no justifican administrar dosis de hormonas a nadie, y este se basa principalmente en modelos murinos.

label.en: That skin has no hormone loops of its own.
label.es-MX: Que la piel no tiene circuitos hormonales propios.

why.en: Skin does run shortened copies of the body's central hormone axes. They explain how skin behaves; they do not justify prescribing a hormone.
why.es-MX: La piel sí cuenta con versiones abreviadas de los ejes hormonales centrales del cuerpo. Explican cómo se comporta la piel; no justifican prescribir una hormona.

label.en: That the loop rests mostly on mouse models, and that local loops explain biology but are no reason to dose anyone with a hormone.
label.es-MX: Que el circuito se basa principalmente en modelos murinos, y que los circuitos locales explican la biología pero no son motivo para administrar dosis de hormonas a nadie.

why.en: Right. The skin's thyroid-like loop comes mostly from mouse models, and the guide calls a local axis foundation, not a dosing rationale.
why.es-MX: Correcto. El circuito tipo tiroideo de la piel proviene principalmente de modelos murinos, y la guía califica al eje local como biología fundamental, no como una justificación para dosificar.

done.en: Read the skin as a screen, give a systemic pattern a systemic answer, and keep local loops as foundation biology, never a reason to prescribe a hormone.
done.es-MX: Interprete la piel como una pantalla, dé una respuesta sistémica a un patrón sistémico y mantenga los circuitos locales como biología fundamental, nunca como un motivo para prescribir una hormona.

body.en: One question to close lesson 1.1.

blocks.sourceNote: Lesson 1.1

prompt.en: Fictional case. A 52-year-old has new thin, easily bruised skin on her forearms, new violaceous striae and newly raised blood pressure. She has read that skin makes its own cortisol and asks whether a cream could calm it. Which reading is right?
prompt.es-MX: Caso ficticio. Una mujer de 52 años presenta piel delgada de reciente aparición que se llena de hematomas con facilidad en los antebrazos, estrías violáceas nuevas y cifras tensionales elevadas de reciente diagnóstico. Ha leído que la piel produce su propio cortisol y pregunta si una crema podría calmarlo. ¿Cuál interpretación es la correcta?

text.en: Her skin's own cortisol explains the picture, so the answer is local.
text.es-MX: El cortisol propio de su piel explica el cuadro, por lo que la respuesta es local.

why.en: Local skin cortisol tunes immune activity where it is made. It does not explain new striae together with new hypertension.
why.es-MX: El cortisol cutáneo local modula la actividad inmunitaria en el sitio donde se produce. No explica las estrías nuevas junto con la hipertensión de reciente aparición.

text.en: The combination is a systemic pattern; the guide lists it as a reason for prompt endocrine referral before any skin treatment.
text.es-MX: La combinación corresponde a un patrón sistémico; la guía la señala como motivo para una derivación endocrinológica oportuna antes de cualquier tratamiento cutáneo.

why.en: Correct. Striae, bruising and new hypertension together point to possible systemic cortisol excess: a body-to-skin signal.
why.es-MX: Correcto. Las estrías, los hematomas y la hipertensión de reciente aparición en conjunto apuntan a un posible exceso sistémico de cortisol: una señal del cuerpo hacia la piel.

text.en: Local and systemic cortisol are interchangeable, so either explanation fits.
text.es-MX: El cortisol local y el sistémico son intercambiables, por lo que cualquiera de las dos explicaciones encaja.

why.en: Local synthesis acts within the skin and runs its own feedback; a systemic syndrome needs a systemic assessment.
why.es-MX: La síntesis local actúa dentro de la piel y tiene su propia retroalimentación; un síndrome sistémico requiere una evaluación sistémica.

feedback.en: Decide which direction the signal runs before you decide what to treat.
feedback.es-MX: Determine en qué dirección viaja la señal antes de decidir qué tratar.

title.en: A map of fourteen million cells.
title.es-MX: Un mapa de catorce millones de células.

body.en: The Hormone Cell Atlas, published in Science in 2026, read the RNA for 379 hormone and receptor genes in about 14 million single cells and nuclei from 47 human tissues, skin among them. From that RNA it predicted which cell types could make a hormone and which could respond to one. It is a map of predicted capacity; it did not measure hormone release.
body.es-MX: El Hormone Cell Atlas, publicado en Science en 2026, analizó el ARN de 379 genes de hormonas y receptores en aproximadamente 14 millones de células individuales y núcleos provenientes de 47 tejidos humanos, incluida la piel. A partir de ese ARN, predijo qué tipos celulares podrían producir una hormona y cuáles podrían responder a ella. Es un mapa de capacidad predicha; no cuantificó la liberación de hormonas.

points.en: RNA for 379 hormone and receptor genes
points.es-MX: ARN de 379 genes de hormonas y receptores

points.en: About 14 million cells and nuclei, 47 tissues
points.es-MX: Aproximadamente 14 millones de células y núcleos, 47 tejidos

points.en: Output: predicted producers and receivers
points.es-MX: Resultado: productores y receptores predichos

blocks.sourceNote: Fei & Huang-Doran et al., Science 2026 · hormonecellatlas.org.uk · Aesthetic & Regenerative Endocrinology, ch. 7

body.en: RNA for 379 hormone and receptor genes, cell by cell, across 47 human tissues including skin.
body.es-MX: ARN de 379 genes de hormonas y receptores, célula por célula, en 47 tejidos humanos, incluida la piel.

body.en: Which cell types could make a hormone and which could respond, including unexpected sites outside the classic glands.
body.es-MX: Qué tipos celulares podrían producir una hormona y cuáles podrían responder, incluidos sitios inesperados fuera de las glándulas clásicas.

body.en: Whether a cell actually makes and releases the hormone, and whether that hormone does anything there.
body.es-MX: Si una célula realmente produce y libera la hormona, y si dicha hormona ejerce alguna acción allí.

audioScript.en: Fourteen million cells is the scale of the Hormone Cell Atlas, a Cambridge-led study published in Science in 2026. The team read the RNA for 379 hormone and receptor genes in single cells and nuclei from forty-seven human tissues, skin included. From those readings they scored each cell type for its predicted capacity to make or to receive a hormone, and they flagged unexpected sites, such as RNA for the gut hormone secretin in a type of immune cell. The Aesthetic and Regenerative Endocrinology guide uses the atlas to argue that the skin, built from every major cell lineage, is plausibly one of the body's largest distributed signalling networks. The word plausibly matters. Everything in the atlas starts from RNA, and RNA tells you what a cell could make. Whether the cell actually makes and releases the hormone is the question the rest of this lesson answers.
audioScript.es-MX: Catorce millones de células es la escala del Hormone Cell Atlas, un estudio liderado por Cambridge publicado en Science en 2026. El equipo analizó el ARN de 379 genes de hormonas y receptores en células individuales y núcleos de cuarenta y siete tejidos humanos, incluida la piel. A partir de estas lecturas, calificaron cada tipo celular según su capacidad predicha para producir o recibir una hormona, y señalaron sitios inesperados, como el ARN de la hormona intestinal secretina en un tipo de célula inmunitaria. La guía Aesthetic and Regenerative Endocrinology utiliza el atlas para sostener que la piel, constituida por todos los linajes celulares principales, es plausiblemente una de las redes de señalización distribuida más grandes del cuerpo. La palabra plausiblemente importa. Todo en el atlas parte del ARN, y el ARN indica lo que una célula podría producir. Si la célula realmente produce y libera la hormona es la pregunta que responde el resto de esta lección.
